evidence.supporting_text: By conceptualizing student critique as a nested activity within the broader learning activity  through the lens of  Cultural- Historical Activity Theory (CHAT), this design-based research examines how students perceive and engage in  critique - including peer critique,  self-critique, critique of AI  concepts, and critique of the curriculum.
